---
title: "Would more pitch damping fix the disagreement?"
---

{{< include _model.qmd >}}

```{python}
# The design that disagrees, then the airframe's own pitch mode measured at the
# same reference condition the static margin uses. The last line is the point:
# the mode's period against the spacing of the nodes meant to resolve it.
NODES = 60
flown = throw_flight(n=NODES, start=(4.5, 6.5, 0.40, 1.0))
DESIGN = ("aspect_ratio", "tail_arm_chords", "h_tail_ratio", "h_tail_incidence")
marched = simulate(*glider(**{k: flown[k] for k in DESIGN}),
                   ballast=flown["ballast"], launch_angle=flown["launch_angle"],
                   v_launch=flown["v_launch"])

mode = short_period({k: flown[k] for k in DESIGN}, flown["ballast"])
spacing = flown["duration"] / NODES
per_cycle = mode["period"] / spacing
gap = flown["duration"] / marched["duration"] - 1

assert mode["zeta"] > 0.9    # already near critically damped, so damping is not it
assert per_cycle < 2         # and the mode is sampled about once per cycle
assert gap > 0.5             # which is what the disagreement is made of
```

::: {.hero-pair}
::: {.hero-ref}
[`{python} f"{mode['zeta']:.2f}"`]{.hero-value}
[damping ratio, already]{.hero-label}
:::
::: {}
[`{python} f"{per_cycle:.2f}"`]{.hero-value}
[nodes per pitch cycle]{.hero-label}
:::
:::

**Answer.** No — the airframe is near critically damped already, so a damping
floor binds on nothing. The calculation gives the missing diagnostic instead:
the pitch mode's period is `{python} f"{mode['period']:.3f}"` s and the nodes
sit `{python} f"{spacing:.3f}"` s apart, so the collocation samples it
[`{python} f"{per_cycle:.2f}"` times a cycle]{.key} and cannot represent it.
Ten would be a floor —
`{python} f"{10 * flown['duration'] / mode['period']:.0f}"` nodes here.

::: {.callout-warning}
## Well damped is not well resolved
A mode can be strongly damped and still be invisible to the grid meant to carry it.
:::

::: {.callout-note}
## Assumed

1. **Short-period approximation**, phugoid dropped.
2. **Cm_alphadot neglected**; AeroBuildup does not supply it.
3. **Derivatives at one reference speed**, as the static margin.
4. **One start**; the surface has several basins.
:::

```{python}
#| echo: false

footer(throw_flight, short_period, simulate)
```
